title: Crashes as deliberate seeding (gorilla in the cage)

tellings.quote: some of these, you know, crashes were and it wasn't really a mission failure, if you will. It was, you know, maybe some seeding.

plain: Some crashes of unexplained craft may not have been accidents at all, but a deliberate "seeding", a way of putting the craft into human hands on purpose. David Grusch, a former US intelligence officer, tells Michels this as something he heard from a man he calls only Luis: some of the crashes, he says, "wasn't really a mission failure, if you will. It was, you know, maybe some seeding." If that were true, whoever flew the craft would have meant for people to find them.
